components.name: VxWorks RTOS Base Layer
components.description: Commercial real-time operating system base layer. Provides deterministic task scheduling and hardware abstraction.

components.description: HTTP/TLS client used for firmware-update downloads and cloud telemetry uploads.

components.name: zlib
components.description: Lossless compression library used to compress/decompress firmware images and logs.

components.name: OpenSSL
components.description: TLS/SSL and general-purpose cryptography library. Handles the device's secure communication channels and certificate processing.

components.name: NTP Daemon
components.description: Time-synchronization daemon for event-timestamp consistency.

components.name: libxml2
components.description: XML processor used to parse configuration files such as IEC 61850 SCL and PLCopen XML.

components.name: SQLite
components.description: Embedded database engine for alarm history, trend buffers, and local configuration storage.

components.name: open62541 OPC UA Stack
components.description: Device-embedded OPC UA server implementation. Provides the tag address space and secure channels.

components.name: libmodbus
components.description: Modbus RTU/TCP master/slave frame-processing library.

components.name: Net-SNMP
components.description: SNMP agent that lets a network management system poll device status.

components.name: Interpeak IPnet TCP/IP Stack
components.description: Network stack for VxWorks-family devices. Handles socket and IP-layer processing.

components.name: DeltaV Configuration Store Service
components.description: Service that persistently stores project configuration, tag definitions, and user-account information, and verifies their integrity.

components.name: DeltaV Control Execution Engine
components.description: Core execution engine that runs the control-logic scan cycle and updates the I/O image table.

components.name: DeltaV Secure Boot and Attestation Module
components.description: Secure boot module performing boot-chain integrity measurement and signature verification.

components.name: DeltaV Alarm and Event Engine
components.description: Engine that performs threshold monitoring, alarm-priority determination, and acknowledge/clear state management.

components.name: DeltaV Authentication and Access Control Service
components.description: Access control service handling user authentication, role-based authorization, and session management.

components.name: DeltaV Trend Buffer Service
components.description: Service that accumulates short-term trend data in a circular buffer and forwards it to the upstream historian server.

components.name: Modbus/TCP Protocol Stack
components.description: Modbus TCP server/client functionality. Handles register and coil access requests.

components.name: OPC UA Server Stack
components.description: Server stack providing the OPC UA address space, subscriptions, and secure channels.

components.name: HART-IP Gateway Stack
components.description: Gateway stack that relays HART instrument commands over IP.

This issue is a result of an incomplete fix for CVE-2015-7704.
